one_liner.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Claude Code 风格的终端交互界面。
one_liner.en: A Claude Code-style terminal interface for DeepSeek Harness.

local: Node.js >=24.9.0 and an interactive stdin/stdout TTY are required; model requests use credentials configured for the selected DSH provider.

config_items.name: DSH_TOOLS_MODE
config_items.description: Choose native or PTC tool execution.

completeness.reason: The TUI covers prompting, sessions, model/provider setup, approvals, tools, and runtime selection; Windows is implemented but not qualified.

code.reason: Typed modules separate UI, provider, session, and launch boundaries; async failures and shutdown paths are handled.

docs.reason: Bilingual usage guidance documents install, controls, runtime configuration, compatibility, and verification limits.

maintenance.reason: 85 commits and a push on 2026-11-06 indicate sustained recent maintenance.

tests.reason: 96 test files are paired with CI on two Node 24 versions and a qualification gate.
